QuestInfo.name: [Carcion] Goddess of the Waters, Keira
QuestInfo.0: Gaon's spear has started to glow again, with a message from #bKeira#k. Hear what she has to say.
QuestInfo.1: Gaon's spear has started to glow again, with a message from #bKeira#k. Hear what she has to say.
QuestInfo.2: Keira, speaking through an image of herself, chastised the two tribes for starting a war over their obsession with her blessings. Then, wracked with a sudden pain, she disappeared, calling out for help. Reflecting on their mistakes, the Anima vow to save her.
